title: Help and Support crash the app without an HTTPS handler
reproduction: Disable the only HTTPS handler on the scratch API34 device; tap Help and Support separately
expected: Preferences stays open and explains that the link cannot open
observed: Both routes separately throw fatal ActivityNotFoundException
fix: Catch unavailable or blocked launches and show a Snackbar
test_evidence: API34 / baseline 02231e91: deep-settings/26-link-crashes.log and 26-support-no-browser.png. Final ac45e299: 64-final-help.xml and 65-final-support.xml; both show the error Snackbar in Preferences. SecurityException injection not tested.

title: GitHub / Help silently does nothing without an HTTPS handler
reproduction: Disable the only HTTPS handler; tap More > GitHub / Help
expected: Explain why the page cannot open
observed: More remains unchanged and the missing handler is reported only in logs
fix: Show the existing unavailable-link message on both failure paths
test_evidence: API34 / baseline 02231e91: deep-settings/25-more-no-browser.xml and PNG. Final ac45e299: 63-more-feedback.xml and PNG show failure feedback in More.

title: Empty user-app picker exposes bulk actions for no apps
reproduction: On a device with no eligible non-system apps open VPN preferences > Exclude user applications and its overflow
expected: Accessible empty-state text and no meaningless bulk choices
observed: Blank content with enabled Select all and Deselect all
fix: Show the empty-state label and omit bulk actions when zero eligible apps exist
test_evidence: API34 deep-settings/18-user-apps.xml; 19-user-menu.xml vs 56-empty-fixed.xml (e4c94ee3). Populated list intentionally not tested.

title: Version and credits overlap at 200 percent font size
reproduction: Open About at stock density and font_scale=2.0 on API34
expected: Credits begin below the taller of the logo and version
observed: Version bottom y626 and credits top y546 overlap by 80 px
fix: Use a bottom barrier for the logo and version
test_evidence: API34 / baseline 29-about-large.xml vs final ac45e299 61-large-fixed.xml: version bottom 626; credits top 689 (previously 546).

title: Short viewport clips license disclosure with no way to scroll
reproduction: Use 1080x1200 portrait at stock density and font_scale=2.0; open About then swipe up
expected: All disclosure text can be brought on screen
observed: Visible license bounds end at viewport bottom; swipe has no effect
fix: Wrap content in a vertical scroll view
test_evidence: API34 / baseline 31-about-short.png and 32-about-short-swipe.xml. Final ac45e299: 61-large-fixed.xml and 62-large-scrolled.xml; swipe revealed full 304 px disclosure at y770..1074 above content bottom 1137.

title: Global, set and source actions have indistinguishable accessible names
reproduction: Open Manage schedules and inspect the three focusable buttons
expected: Each accessible action name identifies its target
observed: All three names are EDIT SCHEDULE
fix: Use distinct visible and accessible labels
test_evidence: API34 / baseline 35-schedules.xml vs final ac45e299 66-schedules-fixed.xml: distinct global, filter set and source labels; all persisted summaries also shown.

title: All More headings and row text fall back to English in Hebrew
reproduction: Set app locale to he-IL on API34 and open More
expected: Two headings, nine row titles and Domain Checker description shown in Hebrew
observed: Layout mirrors but its 12 text strings remain English
fix: Provide only the 12 More screen resource keys in values-iw
test_evidence: deep-settings/46-he-before.xml and PNG vs 52-he-fixed.xml and PNG (e4c94ee3); localized icon descriptions also present.
